Class PhotoViewer

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.controllers.PhotoViewer
public final class PhotoViewer extends Object
Modal photo viewer with zoom controls, mouse-wheel zoom and previous/next navigation. Opened by clicking any listing photo in the buyer/seller/admin screens.
